description: Moderate a community entry as the app owner: approve or reject a pending entry, remove a published one, suspend a published one while a case is open, or restore a rejected/suspended/removed one. `suspend` hides the entry but is reversible and keeps everything; `remove` is the final one. `reject`, `remove` and `suspend` require a `reason` from the fixed taxonomy; the author receives the reason and your `message` live (communityUpdated) and in their own list. `reason` is one of: copyright, inappropriate, hate, harassment, spam, illegal, privacy, other. Note which queue you are working: the automatic action at the report threshold leaves the entry with status `pending` and `moderation.by = "reports"`, alongside entries merely awaiting first approval. `remove` keeps the entry and its payload so an appeal can be honoured.

message.description: Plain-text explanation the author will read
